AVGO.headline: D.A. Davidson’s Gil Luria Delivers Nvidia Evaluation after Jensen Huang's Return
AVGO.summary: In this NYSE Live interview, Gil Luria, Managing Director and Head of Technology Research at D.A. Davidson, discusses Nvidia, artificial intelligence, semiconductor demand, investor sentiment, and opportunities across technology markets. Kristen Scholer spoke with Luria about AI infrastructure, cloud computing, technology valuations, enterprise adoption, and the outlook for major semiconductor and hyperscale companies. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA) and the implications of Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The interview also explores why Luria believes AI demand remains strong despite recent volatility across technology stocks. Another major theme is the disconnect between market sentiment and the underlying growth being experienced throughout the AI economy. The conversation further examines spending trends related to artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, and advanced computing. The interview also highlights opportunities among semiconductor companies including Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO), Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU), and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD). Another key topic is the importance of cloud providers such as Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN), Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), and Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) within the AI ecosystem. The discussion explores the role these companies play in supplying the compute infrastructure necessary to support AI development and deployment. Additionally, Luria discusses investor concerns surrounding AI regulation, safety, and increasingly powerful models. The conversation further examines Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANTH) and broader questions about the future of the AI industry. Another focus is valuation and why many technology companies may appear attractive despite ongoing uncertainty. The interview also highlights the potential for AI-driven productivity gains across a wide range of industries and business functions. Looking ahead, Luria expects investors to continue monitoring AI adoption, semiconductor demand, cloud infrastructure growth, technology valuations, and emerging AI applications. Throughout the discussion, Luria shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, semiconductors, cloud computing, enterprise technology, innovation, market strategy, AI infrastructure, technology investing, productivity, and digital transformation. He also highlighted India's long-term digital growth opportunity, driven by smartphone adoption, increasing internet access and strong earnings growth. SKHY.headline: EMQQ Global on emerging markets and the AI opportunity
SKHY.summary: Kevin Carter, Founder and Chief Investment Officer of EMQQ Global and the INQQ Fund joined Steve Darling from Proactive about the impact of artificial intelligence on emerging markets, the dominance of the AI “Mag Three” and investment opportunities across the emerging market internet sector. Carter highlighted Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), Samsung and SK Hynix as the leading beneficiaries of AI infrastructure spending, describing the semiconductor companies as the “picks and shovels” leaders of the AI buildout. He noted that these three companies have accounted for approximately 90% of emerging market index returns this year, highlighting their profitability amid continued investment in AI infrastructure. Carter also discussed the competition between the United States and China across five key layers of artificial intelligence: power, semiconductors, data centres, large language models and applications. He highlighted China's electricity capacity, the adoption of Chinese open AI models and their cost advantages. Turning to investment opportunities, Carter discussed the attractive valuations of emerging market internet companies, highlighting Tencent and MercadoLibre as businesses well positioned to deploy AI through their established digital platforms and extensive customer data. He also highlighted India's long-term digital growth opportunity, driven by smartphone adoption, increasing internet access and strong earnings growth.
